rows.grounds: the act or standard of measuring
aṅgula as the unit of measure

items.question: What unit of measurement is exclusively required for constructing the ritual fire-pit?
premises: The measurement must be made using the finger unit.
No other unit of measurement may be used.
This restriction applies at all times without exception.
items.inference: The ritual fire-pit must always be measured exclusively in finger units.
uncertainties: The specific length standard of the aṅgula unit is not defined in this verse.
items.plain_english: The measurement should be made by the finger, and never by any other unit at any time.
